{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ily57r",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 is defined as a PLC low-pressure input active below 4.5 bar (claim-nhxx37). The pressure at P-R dropped to 4.1 bar by 10:00:40 and remained below the threshold until clearing above 5.0 bar around 10:06:24, which aligns with the alarm occurring at 10:00:32 (finding-jmeezw). The 'COMP FAULT' label is a legacy artifact not indicative of compressor status.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-jmeezw", "claim-nhxx37"],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, the alarm would not have triggered.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; evidence supports low-pressure trigger over compressor fault given legacy label context and timing alignment with pressure drop below threshold.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact physical cause of the pressure drop at P-R (source vs distribution system) remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-18ljag6",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop occurred only at P-R while upstream P-U remained stable, indicating a localized issue downstream of the North gallery or within the RHOB distribution path. This condition directly contributed to triggering AL-44.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the pressure drop had occurred upstream at P-U, AL-44 would not have triggered as it monitors only P-R.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; evidence supports localized issue based on differential pressure readings.",
      "evidenceGap": "The specific equipment or process condition causing the pressure loss is unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1lde5sa",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation between Utilities and RHOB that the air-low alarm was understood may have contributed to delayed response or misinterpretation of the event, though this remains an inference due to lack of explicit communication records.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["q-8irrr9"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If confirmation had been documented and understood, response might have been faster or more accurate.",
      "competingExplanation": "Alternative explanation: Standard procedures may not require explicit documentation for alarm acknowledgment; delay could be due to other factors like workload or system latency.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence exists confirming whether communication occurred verbally or via radio/phone, nor if a breakdown actually happened."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-baeffs",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify the point of interruption or valve states, which may have contributed to confusion about whether work was authorized during the pressure loss.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the log had specified valve states or authorization status, confusion might have been reduced.",
      "competingExplanation": "Alternative explanation: The lack of detail in logs is standard practice and not indicative of a procedural failure unless proven otherwise.",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact point at which air supply was interrupted remains unknown."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event (AL-44 alarm triggered) was caused by low pressure at P-R dropping below the threshold, supported by evidence showing a localized issue downstream of North gallery. Contributing factors include lack of documented confirmation for alarm understanding and incomplete shift log details about valve states or interruption points.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Exact cause of pressure drop at P-R (source vs distribution system)", "Whether communication breakdown occurred between Utilities and RHOB", "Specific equipment or process condition causing the air-low indication"],
    "alternatives": ["Pressure loss originated upstream but was masked by sensor error; unlikely given stable P-U readings.", "Alarm triggered due to false signal rather than actual pressure drop; contradicted by multiple data points showing consistent low-pressure trend."],
    "confidence": 0.85
  },
  "evidenceRequests": []
}
